rationale: Automating appointment reminders and no-show prediction on top of an existing scheduling app (integration_depth=1) for a single small practice (org_scale=0); this is appointment/scheduling metadata, not clinical content, so data_sensitivity=0 and no onsite work is involved.

Prior-authorization requests are re-keyed across three insurance portals from the EHR (integration_depth=2, multiple/legacy systems) for a 450-bed hospital network (org_scale=2); the requests carry clinical/insurance data tied to identifiable patients, so data_sensitivity=2 and phi_involved is true, forcing human review regardless of complexity bucket.
